research_question: Does a fixed minimum-component-rank rescue aggregator improve candidate_recall@K and downstream three-line portfolio outcomes versus the exact uniform baselines, with the five component signals and three-line allocator geometry held fixed?
novelty_statement: A single fixed aggregation rule not previously found in repository search. E080 tested equal-weight Borda rank-sum; E081 tests the complementary one-expert-rescue rule. No parameter grid, feature addition, weight search, or allocator search is allowed.

prior_work_boundary.E080: Borda rank-sum aggregation on targets 401..1250; not minimum-component-rank rescue.
prior_work_boundary.E077: Trailing-100 dynamic selector among successor ticket models; one-ticket selector, not candidate rank aggregation.
prior_work_boundary.E079: Fixed E054 candidate bank allocator structure ablation; no candidate rank aggregation.
prior_work_boundary.E044: Prior-only tail24 dynamic ranker selection; different candidate-generation design.
prior_work_boundary.duplication_control: Only one fixed min-rank rule is registered; no post-result variants may be introduced.

historical_evaluation.cutoff_rule: For each target t, features and component ranks use only rounds 1..t-1. Target outcomes are accessed only after ranks are frozen for that target.
historical_evaluation.evidence_limit: All targets are historical diagnostics. No result can be called untouched, prospective, or future confirmation.

candidate_stage.feature_definitions: Exact automation/candidate_recall_v1.py features: population z-scores; recent30 counts over prior 30 draws; gap in completed draws since last main-number appearance; momentum=(last10 frequency/10)-(preceding20 frequency/20), with exact integer ranking score 2*count(last10)-count(preceding20); balanced=(recent30_z+gap_z)/2; contrarian=(-recent30_z+gap_z)/2.

model.name: MIN_RANK
model.formula: For each number n, compute five component rank positions. Sort ascending by minimum component rank; ties by ascending sum of five component ranks; then ascending number.
model.weights: No weights; all five component ranks enter the tie-break sum only.

candidate_stage.metric: candidate_recall@K = mean over targets of winning main numbers among top K divided by 6.
candidate_stage.random_baseline: Exact uniform K-subset expectation K/45; 200 target-matched uniform K-subsets per target using deterministic Mulberry32/Fisher-Yates schedule.
candidate_stage.miss_trace: For each of six winning-number slots per target, store min-rank, Borda, consensus and five component rank positions, best component and whether min-rank top30 retained it. Do not store winning number values, candidate lists or top30 numbers.

inference.bootstrap: Two-sided percentile moving-block bootstrap, 50-target contiguous blocks, 17 full blocks sampled with replacement, final 1-target remainder retained in every replicate.
inference.baselines: Consensus and Borda comparisons are descriptive only; only MIN_RANK versus exact uniform is confirmatory within this historical diagnostic.

portfolio_stage.allocator: Fixed top-18 MIN_RANK order partition: ranks 1-6, 7-12, 13-18 form exactly three six-number lines.
portfolio_stage.geometry: Three pairwise-disjoint six-number lines, union18; no allocator search or modification.

exact_geometry_matched_null.geometry: Three disjoint six-number tickets with union18
exact_geometry_matched_null.calculation: Independent combinatorial enumeration over hit counts a,b,c in each ticket and d=6-a-b-c outside the union; weight C(6,a)C(6,b)C(6,c)C(27,d)/C(45,6).

portfolio_stage.matched_random: 120 uniform random label permutations per target, partitioned into three disjoint six-number lines; deterministic Mulberry32/Fisher-Yates.

inference.bootstrap: Two-sided percentile moving-block bootstrap, 50-target blocks; 17 full blocks sampled with replacement; final 1-target remainder retained.
inference.nonoverlapping_block_stability: 17 full non-overlapping 50-target blocks; final 1-target remainder reported separately; any2-positive full-block share minimum 0.65.

guardrails: No future leakage; target t uses rounds through t-1 only.
No candidate numbers, top30, core/tail or purchase lines in user-facing output.
No clean-holdout or prospective claim for historical targets.
No parameter search, no post-hoc threshold changes, no random fallback.
Three-line policy only; historical five-line results cannot qualify target 1252.
